description: This file defines the MockHandler class used for testing HTTP requests by simulating responses or exceptions from a queue. It includes methods for creating the handler with middleware, managing the queue, and handling request invocation.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A handler that returns queued responses or throws exceptions, used for testing HTTP client behavior.

methods.name: createWithMiddleware
methods.description: Creates a HandlerStack with a new MockHandler, optionally with a response queue and callbacks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockHandler with an optional queue of responses/exceptions/callables/promises and callbacks.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles a request by returning a queued response or throwing an exception, simulating an HTTP request.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds responses, exceptions, callables, or promises to the queue.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last request received by the handler.

methods.name: getLastOptions
methods.description: Returns the options of the last request.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining items in the queue.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the on_stats callback with transfer statistics.
